status: Upstream elekloader core-a4 0.2 for Analog Four MKII OS 1.56 (merged in irpina/elekloader#180): core-ar2's hook bus and mod storage at the A4's addresses, plus core-ar2 0.4's parameter pages and the A4's own page-key views. No release tag yet; Modwerk's linker links it byte for byte as elekloader does.

events.name: ev_tick
events.when: the UI compose check, approximately 20 Hz
events.handler: void f(void *ctrl); set ctrl + 0x20 to 1 to request redraw; not an audio-rate clock

events.name: ev_draw
events.when: after the OS composes the 128 x 64 screen

events.name: ev_key
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

events.name: ev_enc
events.handler: int f(void *brain, void *event); nonzero consumes the event

events.name: ev_settings
events.when: building the GLOBAL key's settings menu; added rows come after SYSTEM

events.name: ev_render_in
events.when: entry of the ColdFire's audio interrupt, the digital path (effects and inputs); the analog voices are not rendered here

events.name: ev_render_out
events.when: exit of the same audio interrupt

events.name: ev_project
events.when: after CREATE NEW or the project reset (how 0), and after every project load, at boot too (how 1); the stored project and its mod data are in place
events.handler: void f(int how, unsigned dropped); dropped flags the global, track, pattern and project scopes that loaded as zeros; keep it short, and start no load or save from it

tables.name: core_pages
tables.purpose: Pointers to struct core_page {page, name, ids[10]} (analog-four-mk2/pages.h): a mod's own parameter page (id 48 or more), or a stock page's entry answered again.

tables.name: core_params
tables.purpose: Pointers to struct core_param {first, last, get, delta, text}: how a range of parameter ids reads, turns and prints; asked in order, the first that answers wins, then stock.

tables.name: core_view_pages
tables.purpose: Pointers to struct core_view_page {type, key, page, shown}: a view for a page, appended to a page key's list for a track type after stock's views; at most 16 in a build.

exports.name: core_additem
exports.purpose: Add a settings row from an ev_settings handler.

exports.name: core_store_get
exports.prototype: unsigned core_store_get(unsigned field, void *item, int index)
exports.purpose: Read a mod storage field (STORE(sym) from analog-four-mk2/store.h); interrupts are masked while it reads.

exports.name: core_store_set
exports.prototype: void core_store_set(unsigned field, void *item, int index, unsigned value)
exports.purpose: Write a mod storage field; a field of the current kit or its sounds is written through to the stored project. Interrupts are masked while it writes.

scopes.sound: 32 bits per sound, in its own spare bytes
scopes.track: 6 x T bits per pattern track (up to 3 bytes each)
scopes.project: what the project's tagged store has left

storage.declare: build.storage: [{ sym, scope, bits }] (1 to 32 bits; sym is a C name). elekloader places each field from the build's lockfile and carries the lockfile after the image.
